title: Spot the Cut
summary: Judy rents a cheap braindance booth in Kabuki to suffer through a commercial BD, and asks V to spot the bad cut.
description: Judy has rented a cheap braindance booth in Kabuki to suffer through a commercial BD. She wants V there to watch it with her and spot the bad cut.

start.bringUp: Judy has rented a cheap braindance booth in Kabuki to watch a commercial BD and wants you there to suffer through it with her. Bring up, in your own way, that you want V to come and watch.

booth.name: the public braindance parlour in Kabuki

JH2.invite.01.text: Commercial BDs are a crime against my profession. Come watch me suffer.

g1.asks: What would you want in a BD of your own life? One moment.
g1.know: The three cuts in the BD they are watching, and which one an editor would never make.

stages.label: Judy and V watch a commercial BD in a Kabuki booth
stages.objective: Watch the commercial BD with Judy in the Kabuki booth
stages.know: You rented two booths in a cheap braindance parlour in Kabuki and are watching a commercial BD. One of its cuts is one an editor would never make.
stages.wants: V to name the bad cut.

choices.means: V names the bad cut correctly
V names the wrong cut or none at all

right.memory: You spotted the bad cut in a commercial BD with Judy in a Kabuki booth, and she was pleased about it.

wrong.memory: You guessed the wrong cut in a commercial BD with Judy in a Kabuki booth, and she gave you a long lecture about it.

left.memory: You left Judy alone in a Kabuki braindance booth before the commercial BD was over.

variations.know: An action BD with a chase Judy picks apart frame by frame.
A romance BD, and Judy says it has three cuts that never happened.
A nature BD with fake birds, and Judy is offended by every one of them.
